composition.summary: The call was compliant with the CMS contract year 2027 marketing rules. The TPMO disclaimer was delivered and delivered before the discussion of any benefits, and the appointment was scheduled after the Scope of Appointment was collected. The call contained a superlative that was not substantiated and did not flag the agent for a superlative issue.
composition.coaching_note: Agent, when discussing the Aetna plan, you should have provided more context about the plan's features and benefits to avoid misleading the customer. Try saying something like, 'The Aetna plan available in Hillsborough County has a $0 monthly premium, a $155 drug deductible, and a $5400 maximum out-of-pocket. This plan also includes a $0 copay for generic medications and a $5 copay for brand-name medications.'
